verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a CLM platform with its own AI features, so letting its AI consume tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or any way to plug external tool servers into Ironclad. The integration evidence covers only outbound access: REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks and embeds, which let other systems call Ironclad rather than letting Ironclad call external tools.
